Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT, Dezvoltare de software personalizat pentru sisteme IT și Servicii de proiectare sisteme IT
Since its foundation in 2007, CCN Holding has become one of Türkiye’s leading and diversified investment groups, operating across Construction, Healthcare, Technology, Education, Tourism and Services.
 CCN Construction Group delivers large-scale EPC and healthcare projects as both a contractor and investor. In 2022, CCN Holding established its Bucharest Branch Office to participate in hospital tenders in Romania and oversee awarded projects. CCN is currently executing the Dimitrie Gerota Emergency Hospital Project for the Ministry of Internal Affairs in Bucharest, SRU Iasi (Spitalul Regional de Urgenta Iasi,) SRU Cluj (Spitalul Regional de Urgenta Cluj), Children Hospital Cluj and continues to expand its international presence through major construction and healthcare projects.
 We are looking for an experienced .NET Backend Developer to join our growing software development team in Romania. You will contribute to the development, enhancement and integration of enterprise software solutions across healthcare, facility management and construction.
 Key Responsibilities 
Design, develop and maintain scalable backend applications using .NET.
Develop RESTful APIs, microservices and system integrations.
Contribute to software architecture and technical design decisions.
Design and optimize database structures and queries.
Ensure application performance, security, reliability and maintainability.
Participate in code reviews, testing and technical documentation.
Collaborate with international development, product management and QA teams.
Evaluate and implement new technologies to improve existing products.
 Required Qualifications 
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science or a related field.
At least 5 years of professional software development experience.
Strong proficiency in C#, .NET and ASP.NET Core.
Experience with RESTful APIs, web services and Entity Framework Core or similar ORM tools.
Strong knowledge of relational databases such as SQL Server or PostgreSQL.
Good understanding of OOP, SOLID principles and design patterns.
Familiarity with microservices and layered architectures.
Experience with Git and collaborative development practices.
Good command of written and spoken English.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills.
 Preferred Qualifications 
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Redis, RabbitMQ or Kafka.
Experience with CI/CD, DevOps, unit and integration testing.
Knowledge of Clean Architecture, DDD or CQRS.
Experience with Azure, AWS or other cloud platforms.
Previous enterprise software development experience.
Romanian language skills.
 📩 Interested in Joining Our Team?
 We encourage you to apply directly through LinkedIn.
 We look forward to meeting professionals who share our commitment to quality, professionalism and successful project delivery.
 Build your future with CCN. Be part of a project that makes a difference.
